definitions.explanation: A physical twisting or warping of an object.
A distorted or complicated state, especially in politics or relationships; a deadlock situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捻|ね}じれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: A twist developed in the wood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{捻|ね}じれ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Diet is in a deadlock situation.
examples.notes: {捻|ね}じれ{国会|こっかい} refers to when different parties control each house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捻|ね}じれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じている→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: There is a complication in their relationship.

notes:
{捻|ね}じれ refers to twisting or distortion, both physical and figurative.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {捻|ね}じれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧: a twist develops
- {捻|ね}じれ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧: divided Diet (political term)
- {捻|ね}じれ⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧: distortion phenomenon

POLITICAL USAGE:
{捻|ね}じれ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ is a common term in Japanese politics, referring to when the ruling party controls the House of Representatives but not the House of Councillors.
